stories.title: Molinare hires Des Carey for Dublin studio
stories.summary: Molinare Creative Group has appointed industry veteran Des Carey as Executive Director, Growth & Innovation for its Dublin-based studio, Elephant Goldfish.
stories.why_it_matters: The appointment signals a strategic push to expand Molinare's international footprint and capabilities in emerging production technologies, leveraging Carey's extensive background in cinematic innovation and global post-production.
verified_facts: Des Carey appointed as Executive Director, Growth & Innovation at Elephant Goldfish.
Elephant Goldfish is a member of the Molinare Creative Group.
Carey previously held senior roles at Light Iron, Company 3, and Samsung.

drafts.concise: We are pleased to share that Molinare Creative Group has appointed Des Carey as Executive Director, Growth & Innovation. Based at the group’s Dublin studio, Elephant Goldfish, Des will lead strategic growth and partnership initiatives. With over 25 years of experience across production and post-production, including senior roles at Light Iron and Samsung, Des brings significant expertise to the team as they continue to expand their international presence. Congratulations to Des on this new role. #Molinare #PostProduction #Dublin
drafts.investor: Molinare Creative Group continues to strengthen its leadership team with the appointment of Des Carey as Executive Director, Growth & Innovation. Based in Dublin at Elephant Goldfish, Des will focus on strategic business development and the integration of emerging production technologies. His extensive international experience, including his tenure as Global Head of Cinematic Innovation at Samsung, aligns with the group's ambition to scale its operations and enhance its service offering across the film and television sectors. #Molinare #Growth #MediaTech
drafts.people: A warm welcome to Des Carey, who joins the Molinare Creative Group as Executive Director, Growth & Innovation. Working from the Elephant Goldfish studio in Dublin, Des will collaborate with teams across the group to drive innovation and new partnerships. His impressive career, which includes co-founding Light Iron and leading cinematic innovation at Samsung, makes him a fantastic addition to the team. We look forward to seeing the impact of his leadership on the group’s continued development. #Molinare #TeamNews #PostProduction

stories.title: Big News for Islington: Your Post Office Is Getting an Upgrade (and a New Best Friend)
stories.summary: UOE is relocating its Islington Post Office to a new, larger site at 129E Upper Street, integrated with its fourth 'Stamp' retail store, effective 14th July.
stories.why_it_matters: The move demonstrates UOE's commitment to high street revitalisation by combining essential community services with a modernised, seven-day-a-week retail experience.
verified_facts: The new Islington branch opens on 14th July at 129E Upper Street, London N1 1QP.
The site features a modernised Post Office alongside the fourth 'Stamp' retail store.
The location will offer extended opening hours, including Sundays from 12 noon to 5pm.
Elliot Jacobs is the CEO of UOE.

drafts.concise: UOE is expanding its presence in Islington with the relocation of its local Post Office to a new, larger site at 129E Upper Street. Opening on 14th July, the new branch integrates a fully modernised Post Office with the fourth 'Stamp' retail store. The site will provide a broader range of services, including courier drop-offs and foreign currency exchange, with extended opening hours seven days a week to better serve the local community. This investment highlights UOE’s ongoing commitment to enhancing the high street experience. #UOE #Islington #RetailInnovation
drafts.investor: UOE continues to execute its growth strategy with the opening of a new, flagship-style location in Islington Square. By co-locating a modernised Post Office with its 'Stamp' retail brand, UOE is creating a high-footfall, multi-service destination that addresses modern consumer needs. The new site at 129E Upper Street, launching 14th July, features extended seven-day trading hours and a curated retail offering, demonstrating the scalability of the UOE model in revitalising essential community infrastructure. This development marks the fourth 'Stamp' store, reflecting the company's disciplined approach to expanding its retail footprint. #UOE #RetailGrowth #HighStreetInvestment
drafts.people: Congratulations to the UOE team on the upcoming launch of their new Islington branch. CEO Elliot Jacobs and his team have worked to create a space that combines essential Post Office services with a modern retail experience, designed specifically for the local community. By extending opening hours to seven days a week and offering a wide range of courier and administrative services, the team is ensuring that vital local infrastructure remains accessible and relevant. We look forward to the doors opening at 129E Upper Street on 14th July. #UOE #TeamSuccess #CommunityRetail

stories.title: International UnTracked Updates
stories.summary: The Delivery Group has issued a comprehensive operational update regarding international delivery disruptions caused by geopolitical instability, adverse weather, and regulatory changes across multiple global regions.

sector_stories.title: Former DeepMind team launches AI robotics startup with robots that learn from workers
sector_stories.summary: Former DeepMind researchers have launched Reimagine Robotics, a startup developing robots that learn tasks directly from human workers through a 'monkey-see, monkey-do' demonstration process.
sector_stories.angle: Advances in intuitive, human-led robot training could significantly reduce deployment times and programming complexity for industrial inspection robotics.
